eyebrow: Disabling an account, called from the playbook
code:
def disable_user_account(user_id, token):
    resp = requests.patch(
        f"https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/users/{user_id}",
        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"},
        json={"accountEnabled": False},
        timeout=10,
    )
    return resp.status_code  # 204 on success
caption: One call, immediate effect -- the reason this step never runs unattended.

Condition_-_Approved (If)
